title: Apply TLP power settings
summary: TLP is a tool that automatically optimizes battery life on Linux laptops. This command applies the current power profile (battery or AC) immediately.

steps.explain: Run TLP to apply the power settings appropriate for the current power source (battery or plugged in).

rollback.explain: To revert to default system power management, you typically need to disable the TLP service or remove it, as there is no single 'undo' command for the applied settings.

warnings: This changes system power management behavior. If your laptop behaves unexpectedly, you may need to disable TLP.
